why: Source: read the unlabelled margin index at the points needed, compute revenue × margin for the answer and test the three other statements (two-year sums, single half-year, ratio of index changes), about 6 steps; question: the same readings and the same four statement checks, about 6 steps.
Source: spot that both area A pies share the same respondents, add four pairs of slices, compare (3 steps); question: the same trap, four pair sums and comparison for route A (3 steps).

Source: multiply the nested pie share by the parent share and reject three statements (no spending data, share-of-subgroup trap, main vs only), about 4 steps; question: the same nested multiplication and the same three rejections, about 4 steps.

Source: read unlabelled indexed lines for four statements (share ratio across weeks, base-week trap, proportional change, point rise comparison), about 5 steps; question: the same four checks of the same kinds on the same kind of chart, about 5 steps.

Source: two growth rates, project two 2016 revenues, read two 2013 margins off gridlines, two profits, compare (about 5 steps); question: the identical chain for footwear and clothing (about 5 steps).
Source: two monthly profits (revenue minus costs or revenue × margin) and their difference (3 steps); question: the same two profits and difference (3 steps).
Source: total the two series and the overall sum, then test four share-of-total thresholds (about 5 steps); question: the same totals and four threshold checks of the same kinds (about 5 steps).
Source: two margins from profit ÷ revenue and their difference in points, ignoring distractor rows (3 steps); question: the same two margins and difference (3 steps).
Source: spot shared respondents, add four pairs of club A slices, compare (3 steps); question: the identical procedure (3 steps).

Source: baseline minutes per unit for two periods, then for each of four options read the staffing step off the unlabelled step chart and compute minutes per unit, then compare (about 10 steps); question: the same baseline, four step readings with calculations and comparison (about 10 steps).
